{{W|Aggressive stance}}: Lunges through an empty space at an opponent and attacks with +2 to your penetration roll. You must lunge through the empty space.
{{W|Defensive stance}}: Attacks an opponent then lunges backward 2 spaces.
{{W|Dueling stance}}: Attacks an opponent with +1 to your penetration roll. The attack is guaranteed to hit and penetrate at least once.
Must be wielding a long blade in your primary hand to use Lunge.
{{W|Aggressive stance}}: Makes an attack against all adjacent opponents.
{{W|Defensive stance}}: Pushes all adjacent creatures back 1 space and attempts to trip opponents. (Strength / Agility save; difficulty 30)
{{W|Dueling stance}}: Attacks an opponent and attempts to disarm them (Strength save; difficulty 25 + Agility modifier). The attack is guaranteed to hit and penetrate at least once.
Must be wielding a long blade in your primary hand to use Swipe.
